notes: API Usage & Costs: service cards shown 3 per row.
New "Update with AI" button: the AI checks the providers' official pricing pages (live web search with Claude) and updates prices and free limits – only sane, changed values, with sources listed.

View process: a live log of every audit and report step – each AI call with model, tokens in/out, cost and time, waits, retries and the exact error – from the lead page, the tables and the Activity panel.
No more page blinking: the lead page updates its progress in place and reloads once when the work is done.
Smoother, faster processing: AI audits and reports always run in detached background workers (up to 3 in parallel, adjustable), never inside a page request that the host may cut off.
Live heartbeat while waiting for the AI (elapsed time), stuck-job detection that never kills a job that is still alive, and Abort now cancels an AI request immediately.
Abort and View process buttons aligned in tables and the Activity panel.
Setu CRM v1.0.1 – first public release (updates every 1.0.0 install).

Prospecting: Google Maps scraper with duplicate-free repeat searches (free IDs-only check first), website & Google Maps audits, AI growth reports (PDF + continuous web report) with optional, cached market research.
Correct Google Places cost tracking per SKU: 1 request = 1 page of up to 20 businesses; IDs-only checks are free.
CRM: leads, pipeline, lead capture (forms, Elementor, Meta & Google Ads, webhooks), appointments with booking links and Google Calendar, automations, AI voice calls.
Branding: separate logos for dark and light backgrounds.
Email via PHP mail or SMTP with presets for Brevo, Mailjet, SendGrid, Mailgun, Amazon SES, ZeptoMail, Postmark, Resend, Gmail, Zoho and more.
One-click updates from GitHub: Releases only or Latest commit.
Security: SSRF protection for website audits, IP-based login and form throttling, no open redirects, CSV formula-injection protection, safe links, hardened sessions and headers.
Performance: report generation split into short background steps, new database indexes, lighter per-page queries, browser caching and compression.
